violations.description: Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Boxes of hot cups were stored on the floor in the back room with the washer and dryer.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. The front hand sink was being used to rinse coffee utensils. It also has a spigot that dispenses water.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with a tight fitting or self closing door. The employee restroom did not have a self closing door.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Broken flooring by the door to the kitchen.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in a clean, dry manner to protect from contamination. Ice Scoop stored handle in ice. Scoop needs to be stored handle up.
Proper storage, labeling, use (3 pts deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (2 pts deducted)
